text:
Maria G.: Hey team — we're onboarding a new org/account in GCP (europe-west4) + an AWS account for EU inference fleet. I sketched a minimal cross-cloud provisioning checklist for quota/limit requests. Can folks review and add anything we usually forget? :eyes:

Jon W.: Looks good. Add GPU quota (A100/80GB) per region, preemptible vs. non-preemptible splits, GPUs-per-project default, and total vCPU quota. Also request external IP quota increase for 0->200 for load testing.

Alex K.: For AWS we need EC2-GPU instance limits (p4d, p5/metal if we'll ever test), and ENI limits per instance type. Don't forget EBS gp3 throughput/IOPS quotas if we'll attach many disks.

Tara S.: Tagging + billing notes: include billing account ID, cost-center tag (cost-center:redwood-llm), team tag (team:infra), and environment (env:staging/production). Add IAM roles: infra-admin, network-operator, billing-viewer.

Maria G.: Good call. I'll add IAM templates. Also: request for VPC quirk — increase routes and custom static routes in europe-west4 and eu-west-1. We hit the 200 route limit last time.

Jon W.: Sample GCP commands for quota reporting if you need to confirm current usage:```bash
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west4 --format="json(quotas)"
# or summary
gcloud compute project-info describe --format="json(quotas)"```

Alex K.: And AWS Service Quotas: request via console or CLI:```bash
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 50
# L-1216C47A is example for Running On-Demand Standard (A, C, D, H, I, M, R, T, Z) Instances (vCPUs) - check exact codes per account
```

Tara S.: Networking items: increase NAT gateway hourly limits? Also request more elastic IPs for nat fallback during tests. Firewall rules also need quota bump to 500.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-7893 to track GCP quota requests and INF-7894 for AWS. Assigned to Maria G. and Jon W. Estimated ETA: 3 business days for approval if we include cost justification.

Maria G.: I'll draft the justification: "Reason: onboarding inference fleet for EU region; expected sustained GPU usage ~120 A100-hours/day; need capacity headroom for canary rolls and failover." Can someone paste previous usage numbers?

Jon W.: Pulling last month's numbers now. Quick peek: peak GPU concurrent = 18 A100s, sustained ~9. I'll paste in the ticket.

Alex K.: Also reminder — request increase in VPC ENI limit for c6gn / p4d sizes in target AWS AZs. We had pod density issues when autoscaling.

Tara S.: Ops checklist addition: 1) add IAM service account with least privilege to make quota requests and tag resources; 2) set up billing alerts for new accounts; 3) add org policy for required tags; 4) pre-create subnets with /20 size for autoscaler headroom.

Maria G.: Perfect. I'm going to update the checklist and attach to INF-7893/7894. If anyone has specific quota numbers they want requested (e.g., request 50 A100 quota vs 30), reply here. :shipit:

Jon W.: Request 40 A100s in europe-west4 and 20 A100s in eu-west-1 (AWS). I'll add notes about staging vs prod split.

Alex K.: +1 on those numbers. I'll file the AWS SCQ with those desired values and include ENI bump to 1000 for the account.

Maria G.: Thanks — I'll move forward with the requests and post updates in the ticket. If approvals are slow we can temp-burst to other regions.

Tara S.: One last thing: include the network contacts for the cloud providers in the request so they route faster (we have an existing account rep). Add "account rep: polina@cloudsales" to the ticket.

infra-bot: INF-7893 updated: GCP quota request submitted (A100: 40, vCPU: 800, External IPs: 200, Routes: 400). INF-7894 updated: AWS quota requests submitted (A100 equiv: 20, ENI: 1000, Elastic IPs: 150). Estimated response time 48-72 hours. 

Maria G.: Great, closing this thread — comments can continue on the tickets. Thanks all! :tada:
